paras: Throw away the factory oil cap and add these sexy oil cap from Leyo Motorsport. Design inspired by the original MK7 GTI Austin wheels, this full OE replacement oil caps are both functional and aesthetically pleasing.
Just remove the o-ring from the OE oil cap and transplant it onto the Leyo oil cap, turn and press it down in place and you now feel like a VW master technician on performing this install.
hl: Constructed from T6061 Billet Aluminium for strength.
Visual improvements to the engine bay.
ft: OEM Replacement Billet Oil Cap - Audi A4 B9 RS Q3 F3 / Volkswagen Golf MK7 Mk7.5
